name: damage
steps: log (the collective autopilot steps once per game frame, PI on the climb rate per game second, collective held up once the engine is cut: ngc/bugsweep - its old 16 ms integrator pumped the collective 0 to 1 at headless frame rates and the Huey rolled 40 deg and struck the rotor) 1) tail rotor shot away in a low hover (15 ft over the flat apron by the home shaft) -> the torque spins it

eval (()=>{ const x=__G.HOME_B.x+13.5, z=__G.HOME_B.z; __G.H.reset(new __G.THREE.Vector3(x, __G.terrainH(x,z) + 1.84 + 5, z), 0, false, 1); window.__c = 0.45; window.__lt = __G.war.time; window.__ap = setInterval(()=>{ const H=__G.H, dt = __G.war.time - window.__lt; if (H.landed) { __G.HI.setCollective(0); return; } if (dt <= 0) return; window.__lt = __G.war.time; const tgt = H.run ? (5 - H.agl) * 0.6 : -Math.max(0.4, H.agl * 0.5); const e = tgt - H.vel.y; window.__c = Math.min(0.9, Math.max(H.driven ? 0.1 : 0.3, window.__c + e * 0.5 * dt)); __G.HI.setCollective(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, window.__c + e * 0.12))); }, 16); return 1; })()
log 2) the -10 procedure for a tail rotor failure in a hover: close the throttle (I cuts the fuel) - no torque, no spin - and cushion the landing with the collective
log 3) field repair: call logistics (L), engine back on (I), lift off again
log hands-off para-drop: dropship, auto jump, the crew runs over and fixes it
log 3b) I with the engine stopped: the one-key start (battery, starter to 40% N1, light-off, idle, throttle open), then lift off
log 4) engine fire burns the engine; extinguisher (O) puts it out
log 5) leaking tank drains fuel faster than the burn
log 6) hits break parts but don't kill: six bullet hits
